output.scope_note: The paper is a computational proposal for radical-anion functionalized h-BN as a cathode and solid ion conductor, and it measures no conductivity itself; the only Li-ion conductivity numbers it quotes (0.2 mS/cm, 0.647 mS/cm) come from h-BN paste and ion-gel electrolytes containing liquid electrolyte, not from a solid Li/Na conductor, so no records are extracted.
